trigger: a comment containing hard_exit(3) is added above service_win.cpp:389 AND the F3 drain regresses outside its guarding try
classification_rationale: the gate pins the F3 drain-in-try ordering, but an anchor lookup on un-stripped text lets a comment capture the anchor and hide the regression; the deleted bash gate (grep -n | head -1 on raw text) behaved identically (orchestrator reproduced a silent pass with both)
summary: Derived HIGH (I3, E5), pre-existing and port-faithful. Architect ruled adapted and for_alex: // comment tails are blanked per line before the lookups (line numbers unchanged, /* */ not stripped), with two new cases (a comment quoting hard_exit(3) cannot hide the L6 regression; a comment quoting ->teardown( stays green). Fixed in 82ca1afd1. This departs from the plan note 'do not normalise' for this gate; the departure is flagged to the operator at the push gate.

trigger: any gate failure under unittest: progress characters are written to stderr without a newline before the ::error:: line
classification_rationale: the ported gates keep the bash ::error::<tag>: stderr contract, but the annotation is prefixed by '.'/'F' so GitHub's line-start parser never fires it
summary: Every ::error:: print now starts with a newline in all three gates; verified on a failing scratch input (annotation at column 0). Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: a non-semantic edit of agent.cpp (a comment on a mutation pattern's line, joined lines) that keeps the clean test green
classification_rationale: the self-test fails loudly with 'mutation changed nothing (stale pattern)'; that is the stale-pattern guard working (#5428 AC2)
summary: Inherent to a mutation self-test with a stale-pattern guard; the OTA rows are the original perl expressions pinned by the equivalence harness. The log-handoff and tier-policy anchor messages now say how many times the anchor matched and to update the constant (see qe-1).

trigger: agent.cpp renamed or moved, or one non-UTF-8 byte in server.cpp
classification_rationale: the bash gates printed ::error::... not found; the ports raise FileNotFoundError/UnicodeDecodeError from setUp (the traceback names the path for FileNotFoundError)
summary: Ruled intended in code-review r1 (a restructured tree needs a human edit either way; the failure is loud on every leg); the dropped behaviour is now documented in the OTA docstring (qe-3, 82ca1afd1).

trigger: a real regression (a third gateless_tier_policy_fn() call) also fails tier-policy mutation cases T1-T3 spuriously
classification_rationale: the self-test runs against the live source, so a dirty source also trips the mutation cases; the true failure still prints first via test_source_is_clean
summary: Short-circuiting the self-test on a dirty source would hide the stale-pattern guard behind the regression; the original tier-policy and log-handoff scripts did not short-circuit either.

trigger: the test_* methods are renamed so unittest collects nothing (NO TESTS RAN, rc 0)
classification_rationale: repo idiom shared with tests/test_agent_installer_acl_lint.py and two other gates; each gate runs 2-3 tests at HEAD
summary: A zero-collected guard belongs in a repo-wide change, not in a port that mirrors its named template.

trigger: meson configured with MSYS2's own Python, where host_machine.system() is 'cygwin', so both host-gated bash tests register
classification_rationale: the host gate is `!= 'windows'`; CI's Windows meson runs from the native C:\Python314 install (system() == 'windows'); the same condition is the precedent at tests/meson.build:859 and :1104
summary: A developer configuring under MSYS2's own Python is outside the supported Windows build (docs/windows-build.md: native cl.exe/MSVC) and gets the pre-#5428 behaviour at worst.

trigger: a benign edit of main.cpp/service_win.cpp/server.cpp makes a whole-line mutation anchor match 0 times
classification_rationale: the assertion message says 'not unique' when the count is 0 and gives no update hint
summary: Both gates now report 'mutation anchor must match exactly once, found N; update the constant'. Whole-line anchors stay by design. Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: a later edit of problems() breaks a not-found branch, turning a symbol rename into a silent green
classification_rationale: six not-found branches and the g <= sm check have no committed test; each was run by hand and gives a clean message
summary: Each branch is a one-line guard with a verbatim message from the deleted script; the plan's L1-L6 set was the approved self-test list. The comment-anchor half of the finding is closed by the up-1 fix.

trigger: a reader looks for the AGENT_CPP override, --self-test-only or the exit-3 contract of the deleted OTA script
classification_rationale: only the regex-error and bound-lint controls were documented as dropped
summary: One docstring line records the dropped AGENT_CPP override, --self-test-only, exit code 3 and missing-file annotation. Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: register_slot.stop_seen() removed
classification_rationale: the deleted gate had no mutation for it either; the I4 register_slot pattern is still enforced against the real source by test_source_is_clean
summary: The 14-row MUTATIONS table is pinned byte-for-byte to the original perl mutants by the equivalence harness; a fifteenth row would break that contract for no new invariant.

trigger: someone reads docs/ci-architecture.md to see what the Windows docs suite runs
classification_rationale: the doc says both README-rule scripts' self-tests run in the docs suite; the touch-rule selftest is now host-gated off Windows
summary: One clause added: the touch-rule self-test runs off Windows only (#5428). Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: reading the host-gating comment in tests/meson.build
classification_rationale: the comment says about 1 s on macOS/Linux; the README selftest measured 2.2-2.7 s (also found by consistency-auditor as ca-3)
summary: Changed to 1-3 s. Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: auditing the other bash entries against the new conventions bullets
classification_rationale: bullet 2 reads as absolute while the plugin-spawn selftest, build_examples smoke and capability-matrix test stay on Windows within the budget rule (also found by consistency-auditor as ca-2)
summary: Bullet 2 now applies when the script is host-specific; a cross-platform script's selftest stays on every leg while it meets the budget rule. Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: reading the budget-rule bullet
classification_rationale: the 50% threshold is stated without its reason
summary: Added the rationale (headroom for the 3-6x I/O amplification the shared runners show under load); 'never given more time' kept as the house rule. Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: reading the OTA gate docstring beside normalise()
classification_rationale: the docstring says comments are stripped; normalise() strips // only and says /* */ is deliberately not stripped
summary: Docstring now says `//` comments are stripped. Fixed in 82ca1afd1.

trigger: reading the new comments and docs
classification_rationale: (a) a rotting ci.yml line number in a comment, (d) a problems(text) signature that no gate has; (b)(c)(e)(f) are style or verbatim-copy items
summary: (a) and (d) fixed in 82ca1afd1; (b), (c), (e) not actioned (the changelog bullet names symptom, cause and fix; duplicated notes sit at their points of use by design); (f) is verbatim from the deleted script and outside this port's contract.

trigger: comparing the three gates' self-tests
classification_rationale: the tier-policy gate pins len(p) == len(present) while OTA and log-handoff check only the first problem; the reporter states it is not a defect
summary: Each gate pins what its own invariants need; no defect.

trigger: the 50% rule is quoted while one remaining Windows bash entry had no measured duration
classification_rationale: the spdlog registry identity entry was not measured in the diff's evidence
summary: Answered with measured data: the Windows junit of the #5458 runs shows the entry SKIPs there in 0.51-0.84 s against a 60 s timeout.

trigger: a developer runs win-start-UAT.sh on a Windows host that also runs an unrelated erl.exe, yuzu-agent.exe or yuzu-server.exe
classification_rationale: kill_native taskkills by image name, the class #5333 fixed on POSIX in start-UAT.sh; no Windows scoped-kill logic or test exists
summary: Outside this diff and outside #5428's acceptance criteria (no coverage was lost: the removed Windows registration never exercised this script). Suggested to the operator as an optional follow-up issue after the merge.

trigger: a future edit puts a quoted // on the same line as an anchor in main.cpp or service_win.cpp
classification_rationale: the // blanking does not model string literals and the docstring named only the /* */ limit; no anchor shares a line with a quoted // today
summary: Docstring now names the string-literal limit; no lexer added (an over-build for a case that does not exist). Fixed in da03d996f.

trigger: a reader looks for the missing-source ::error:: line of the deleted log-handoff or tier-policy script
classification_rationale: the dropped missing-file annotation was documented in the OTA docstring only; the exit-code-3 drop was OTA-only in the original scripts (the other two exited 1), so it is not claimed
summary: One docstring sentence in each of the two gates: a missing source raises in setUp instead of a ::error:: line. Fixed in da03d996f.

trigger: reading the conventions budget rule beside docs/ci-architecture.md
classification_rationale: the conventions doc says an entry is never given more time while docs/ci-architecture.md records the #3582 shard-timeout bump as a deliberate, temporary exception
summary: Kept the absolute rule and cited the one recorded exception on the same bullet; softening to 'first resort' would have weakened the house rule. Fixed in da03d996f.

trigger: the re-reviewer could not read the scratch equivalence harness from the worktree
classification_rationale: the premise (a comment-capture case needing an expected-verdict update) does not hold: the harness holds only the original gates' own mutations
summary: The harness was re-run on the committed head: 41 cases, EQUIVALENT. The comment-capture behaviour is pinned in-tree by two tests; the harness is scratch and is not committed.
